_comment: Per-dataset metadata used by the analysis pipeline. Keys are the dataset names as passed to --dataset.

liar.notes: LIAR (Wang 2017). Claims were collected 2007-2016. Date column present but all values are 'na'. Use dataset_year as fallback.

fakecovid.notes: FakeCovid (Shahi & Nandini 2020). Claims collected Jan-May 2020. Per-row date column available.
